project.name: horde-soldiers-v2
project.principle: ONE BRAIN. MULTIPLE BODIES. SHARED STRATEGY. INDEPENDENT EXECUTION.
project.summary: Forge mod: hordes of zombies/soldiers/scavengers/terrorists; one strategic HordeController per horde, followers read shared state + formation slots.

build.tests: com.nox.horde_soldiers.test.LogicTests - 130 checks, headless bootstrap via reflection

dataFlow: EntityJoinLevel -> HordeRegistry.attach -> HordeController (leader strategy, throttled) -> HordeData (persisted via HordeSavedData + HordeLink NBT) -> follower goals -> guarded world edits (LootTransfer, ZombieBreachRules)

files.description: Forge @Mod entry point: registers config, entities, capabilities, creative-tab listener, event listeners (commands, entity join, death, server tick/stop, wave manager).
Entity renderer registration; per-type skin pools (textures/entity/skins/<type>/), skin picked deterministically from the entity UUID (SkinVariant).
/horde start|stop|status|list|wave|spawn <type> [count]|order <order> [radius]|dismiss [radius]. Orders apply to HordeControllers only.
ForgeConfigSpec COMMON spec: general/wave, horde engine intervals, zombie breach rules, per-type stats + naturalSpawn + randomWeapons flags, faction overrides, taming (enabled/item/chance).
PathfinderMob base for humanoid members: HordeLink + persisted 27-slot ItemStackHandler capability + ITameableHorde owner (NBT-persisted); never despawns while in a horde or tamed.
Horde membership contract: hordeId, leader flag, HordeType.
Taming contract: isTamed/getOwnerUUID/setTamed.
Medic healer: never fights, heals friendly entities in an aura (HealAlliesGoal), medic skin pool, tameable.
DeferredRegister: 4 entity types + 4 spawn eggs (also added to the vanilla Spawn Eggs creative tab) + attributes.
Looter: spawns with a random melee weapon, retreat defense + leader-assigned loot via LootContainerGoal, tamable.
Deterministic per-UUID skin index + skin texture path; unit-tested.
Armed soldier: random rifle-class TACZ gun + matched ammo (or fixed config gun), SoldierTaczCombatGoal, tamable (follow/defend owner).
Hostile raider: random TACZ gun (any class) + matched ammo when terroristsUseGuns, melee fallback.
Horde zombie: breach goal, faction targeting, config health/damage, isSunSensitive() override, vanilla door-breaking disabled so all breaching goes through ZombieBreachRules.
Target selector restricted to FactionManager-hostile entities; followers defer to the shared controller target.
Medic heal aura: heals + regenerates allies/owner in radius on an interval.
Follower movement toward the published formation slot; budgeted recovery path only when stuck/separated.
Paths to leader-assigned loot container, runs LootTransfer (simulate-first, lossless).
Flees nearest hostile when health below scavengerRetreatThreshold %.
Tamed scavengers go to work (disappear 5 min, return with loot) when owner is near and no hostiles.
TACZ combat: aim/shoot with computed yaw-pitch, reload from own inventory, strafing; respects CEASE_FIRE/RETREAT.
Tamed mobs follow their owner (move/look flags); no-op when wild.
Tamed mobs target whoever last hurt their owner (or whom the owner last hurt).
Breacher-only mining of the shared breach target; holds a per-dimension breach slot; re-validates rules every tick.
Central breach rules: breachEnabled, mobGriefing, whitelist/blacklist, pickaxe-for-stone.

Random weapon provisioning: melee pool (swords/axes/tridents/melee-named mod items with attack damage), random TACZ guns (rifle-only or any), ammo matched via IAmmo.isAmmoOfGun. Pure matchers unit-tested.
Forge event wiring: attributes, capabilities, commands, entity join (re-attach), death (detach), server tick, server stopping, taming interact (PlayerInteractEvent.EntityInteract).
PLAYER, SOLDIER, ZOMBIE, SCAVENGER, TERRORIST.
MC-aware facade: entity->faction mapping, config overrides, tamed-owner ALLIED overrides, all hostility checks.
ALLIED/NEUTRAL/HOSTILE + lenient parse().
Pure symmetric relation matrix with runtime overrides; unit-tested.
Stable slot assignment: UUID-sorted, leader slot 0, others unique 1..n-1 (collision fixed).
Pure formation offset math for 4 types; unit-tested.
Slot = index + offset + world pos; NBT-persisted.
FOLLOW_TRAIL/PROTECT_LEADER/COMBAT_SPREAD/HOLD_POSITION.
ONE strategic brain per horde: throttled targeting, orders, formation, primary path (leaderPathInterval), loot scan, breach designation; UUID-only state.
Serializable shared horde state + NBT round-trip.
Per-entity membership holder persisted in entity NBT.
Timed wave event: zombie hordes near random overworld players; size = zombieHordeSize + min(cap, wave/2*growth); spawnCap per dimension.
Per-member record: role, slot, stuck/separated detection, path cooldown, dormancy; NBT-persisted.
Hybrid navigation helpers: slot correction + budgeted/cooldown recovery pathing.
9 orders + parse().
Per-dimension registry: one controller per horde, entity index, breach counter, path budget, batched saves (saveInterval). Never force-loads chunks.
SavedData storing horde states + entity index.
Group spawn: leader+followers in one controller, stable slots, faction init, TACZ provisioning, breacher designation; no orphans.
IDLE/ACTIVE/COMBAT/RETREATING/DISBANDING.
4 horde types mapped to factions + parse().
Deterministic leader election (leader flag > health > age, UUID tiebreak); unit-tested.
Lossless container->inventory transfer: simulated probe insert (duplication bug fixed), real extract only for what fits, remainder put back/dropped.
ACTIVE/STUCK/SEPARATED/COMBAT/RETREATING/IDLE.
Work-trip scheduler: pending workers, 5-min duration, loot generation, SavedData persistence, return-to-owner.
Mod items + creative tab: taming_treat, war_horn, support_call_1..5, tab Horde Soldiers (HZCODE).
Support Call xN: right-click spawns a soldier horde of size N at the player.
Horde War Horn: right-click starts/stops the timed horde event.
Places the camp blocks: 9x9 plank/cobble platform, corner fences + torch, campfire, loot chest/barrel (chests/horde_camp loot table).
Horde camp structure: picks a surface point per chunk, returns a GenerationStub with one HordeCampPiece.
DeferredRegister: structure type hzcode:horde_camp + its piece type.
TACZ API bridge (IGunOperator/IGun/IAmmo): equipSoldier, aim/shoot/reload, ammo matching; safe no-ops without TACZ.
Registers ON_GROUND spawn placements for all 4 types in common setup; config-gated (naturalSpawn), vanilla monster rules for zombies.
